faith.text: Rise like a lion in the morning to serve your Creator, so that you awaken the dawn.
I thank You, living and eternal King, for You have returned my soul to me with compassion. Great is Your faithfulness.
If I am not for myself, who will be for me? And if not now, when?
The day is short and the work is great.
Be bold as a leopard, light as an eagle, swift as a deer and strong as a lion to do the will of your Father in Heaven.
It is not your duty to finish the work, but neither are you free to neglect it.
Who is strong? One who conquers his inclination.
How long will you lie there, sluggard? When will you rise from your sleep?
This is the day the LORD has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
His mercies are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness.

philosophy.text: At dawn, when you have trouble getting out of bed, tell yourself: I have to go to work, as a human being.
Waste no more time arguing what a good man should be. Be one.
While we are postponing, life speeds by.
First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise.
Morning is when I am awake and there is a dawn in me.

facts.text: Daylight in the first hour after waking helps set your body clock.
Morning grogginess (sleep inertia) usually fades within 15 to 30 minutes.
Adults need 7 to 9 hours of sleep a night.
A regular wake time, even on weekends, makes mornings easier.
Snoozing fragments the end of your sleep. Getting up at the first alarm usually feels better.
You lose water overnight just by breathing. A glass of water helps you wake up.
Screens before bed delay falling asleep.
Caffeine has a half-life of about five hours.

jokes.text: I told my alarm clock a joke. It didn't laugh, but it went off anyway.
Why did the alarm clock get promoted? It always showed up on time.
The snooze button is like a loan: you pay it back with interest in grogginess.
My bed is perfect every morning. Shame that's exactly when I have to leave it.
The early bird gets the worm, but the second mouse gets the cheese.
I tried to get up early. My bed objected, and it's bigger than me.
